description.7.0: Assigns properties to hybrid bolt elements in the range. Refer to Hybrid Properties for a detailed description of the properties. The following properties are available.
description.9.0: Assigns properties to hybrid bolt elements in the range. Properties include cross-sectional-area, density, dowel-active-length, dowel-failure-strain, dowel-stiffness, dowel-yield, grout-cohesion, grout-friction, grout-perimeter, grout-stiffness, slide, slide-tolerance, tensile-failure-strain, thermal-expansion, yield-compression, yield-tension, young, grout-cohesion-table, grout-friction-table. Refer to Hybrid Properties for a detailed description of the properties. The following properties are available.

keywords.name: grout-cohesion
keywords.description: grout cohesion (force units) per unit length

description.9.0: name of the table relating grout cohesion to relative shear displacement
